caption: The sound of a freezing bubble 🫧 I recently came across a fun winter experiment while scrolling through social media. The idea is simple: blow a bubble, place it on a surface, and watch as it freezes in the cold ❄️ But what does it actually sound like? On a freezing day at -20°C, I decided to find out. I set up an omnidirectional microphone, covered it with a thin plastic film for protection, and carefully placed a bubble on top. The result? A surprisingly satisfying sound! But was it really the bubble freezing… or just the plastic reacting to the cold? Either way, it was a fun experiment with a nice result 🔊 ⚠️ No microphones were at risk in the making of this recording. I made sure to keep it well protected. I would like to thank Centre Bang for hosting me and allowing me to explore their forest. #science #scienceexperiments #bubble #pourtoi #fyp
